name: DayOtter
description: Open-source, AI-native scheduling. Connect every calendar, never get double-booked, share one booking link that respects them all.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Session signing secret (32+ random chars). Auto-generated.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: MUST be 64 hex chars for encrypting calendar tokens at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

APP_URL.description: Your app's public URL, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.description: Same as APP_URL. NOTE: baked into the web bundle at build time - set it, then trigger a rebuild (git push / redeploy) for client-side links to pick it up.

AI_PROVIDER.description: Optional: "anthropic" or "openai". Leave blank to run with no AI (DayOtter is a full scheduler without it).
